exposure: Bladder exstrophy (history of multiple surgeries for correction)
outcome: Healthy neonate with normal Apgar score
cohort: A 39-year-old pregnant woman (gravida 2, para 1) with a history of bladder exstrophy and uterine prolapse, presenting at 39 weeks of gestation.
finding: Multidisciplinary management of pregnancy complicated by bladder exstrophy and uterine prolapse may lead to optimal perinatal outcomes, and uterine prolapse may disappear after delivery.
mod_finding: An emergent cesarean section was performed due to abnormal fetal heart rate tracing, resulting in the birth of a healthy neonate.
